Dallas, TX | (469) 555-0152 | david.mensah@email.com | linkedin.com/in/davidmensah
SUMMARY
PMP-certified project manager with eight years leading IT and operations projects of up to $4M for health care and
logistics companies. Comfortable with both Agile and waterfall teams.
EXPERIENCE
Pecanwood Health System Dallas, TX
Senior Project Manager Feb 2022 – Present
• Led a $4M patient scheduling system rollout across 14 clinics with a 22-person team; went live on schedule and
6% under budget
• Set up the project intake process and status reporting that the PMO now uses for about 30 projects a year
• Run weekly risk reviews with IT, clinical and finance leads and report status to the executive steering committee
• Coach three junior project managers on scheduling, vendor contracts and stakeholder updates
Brindlewood Freight Systems Fort Worth, TX
Project Manager Aug 2018 – Jan 2022
• Managed the move of two warehouses to a new management system with no missed shipments during cutover
• Delivered 11 Agile releases of the carrier portal with a team of eight developers in two-week sprints
• Negotiated the scope and payment schedule with the software vendor and kept change orders under 5% of
contract value
Brindlewood Freight Systems Fort Worth, TX
Operations Analyst Jun 2016 – Jul 2018
• Tracked on-time delivery for 120 carriers and built the weekly scorecard used in carrier reviews
EDUCATION
Trinity Plains University Denton, TX
Bachelor of Science in Information Systems May 2016
SKILLS
Certifications: PMP, Certified ScrumMaster
Methods: Agile, waterfall, risk management, budgeting
Tools: Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project
Industries: Health care, logistics, software
